# Kuaa UI

> A collection of beautifully animated, copy-paste ready React components built with Motion (Framer Motion). Designed for developers who want production-quality UI with zero friction.

## About
- [Home](https://kuaa-ui.vercel.app/): Landing page showcasing the library's style and philosophy
- [Docs](https://kuaa-ui.vercel.app/documents): Component documentation with live demos and copy-paste code

## Components
- SplitText — Animated text split by characters or words
- MaskReveal — Reveal text or elements with a sliding mask
- RollingNumbers — Smooth animated number counter
- GlitchEffect — Cyberpunk-style glitch animation
- Carousel — Smooth, draggable carousel component
- DecodeText — Matrix-style text decode animation
- TypeText — Typewriter animation
- Blob — Organic morphing SVG blob
- BorderBeam — Animated border beam / glow effect
- LiquidGlass — Frosted glass morphism effect
- Dialog — Animated modal dialog
- StaticIcons — Custom SVG icon set
- Kaomoji — Kaomoji character icon set

## Tech Stack
- React 18 + TypeScript + Vite
- Motion (formerly Framer Motion)
- React Router v6
- vite-react-ssg (static site generation)
